name: ATM Key Download Request 6
definition: Information related to the request of a key download from an ATM.

CommandResult.name: Command Result
CommandResult.definition: Result of a maintenance command performed by the ATM.

CommandContext.name: Command Context
CommandContext.definition: Security command in progress inside which the key download is requested.

ATMSecurityContext.name: ATM Security Context
ATMSecurityContext.definition: Context of the ATM for the key download.

ATMSecurityParameters.name: ATM Security Parameters
ATMSecurityParameters.definition: Security parameters of the ATM for the initiated key download.

HostChallenge.name: Host Challenge
HostChallenge.definition: Random value from the host provided during a previous exchange.
